subject: Request to Publish Customer Testimonial / Quick Approval Check
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightwave.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — can we publish a short case quote from BrightWave?

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the support rollout last quarter — the team at BrightWave has seen meaningful latency improvements in our search assistant since moving to your dedicated pool. Marketing would love a short customer quote (1–2 sentences) and permission to write a 1-page case study featuring BrightWave + Redwood.

Would you be OK with the following: a 30-minute interview with our customer success team next week, permission to publish a brief quote attributed to BrightWave, and an advance copy for approval? I'm attaching our standard request form.

Timing is modestly important for our June newsletter, but we can be flexible.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Customer Marketing, BrightWave Labs
(elena.ruiz@brightwave.io)

Attachment: brightwave-testimonial-request.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightwave.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we publish a short case quote from BrightWave?

Hi Elena — appreciate the note and the kind words. We're excited to hear BrightWave wants to share the story.

Looping in Monica from Customer Success to confirm the interview logistics and to validate the scope of what's safe to publish. Also tagging Legal/Product briefly to check for any sensitivity. Will get back with an estimated timeline by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Onboarding link: https://app.redwood.ai/onboarding/BW-78

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we publish a short case quote from BrightWave?

Quick heads-up — before we commit to any publication, we should flag a sensitivity check. BrightWave had a partial outage tied to the model cache eviction on 2026-04-28 (ticket INC-1142). Their renewal conversation is still active and their CSAT dipped in the April survey.

I recommend: pause any public-facing quote until CS confirms there are no outstanding remediation items and Legal signs off on redacted incident references. If Marketing needs a timeline, suggest 3–4 weeks post-renewal or after remediation completion, whichever is later.

I've attached a redacted incident summary for context.

--Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: incident-summary-redacted.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we publish a short case quote from BrightWave?

Agree with Marcus. From a GTM/renewal perspective we should avoid any external promotion that could be perceived as tone-deaf while there's a live remediation and renewal conversation.

Neha — can you ask Marketing to accept a delayed publish window and offer BrightWave an advance copy they can veto? Also flag to Legal to determine if the quote needs specific wording that avoids operational specifics. If we can secure a short attributable quote that focuses on product outcomes (e.g., latency improvements) and not operational history, Legal may greenlight earlier.

Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightwave.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we publish a short case quote from BrightWave?

Hi Elena — thanks for the request and for sending the form. We really value telling BrightWave's story. That said, I need to ask that we pause any public publication for the moment.

We discovered an operational incident in late April that Marcus and our CS team are still coordinating with you on; Legal and Sales would prefer to wait until the remediation and renewal conversation are fully complete before we publish a formal case study. This is to avoid any perception issues while a customer is evaluating next steps.

If it's helpful, we'd be happy to:
- Share an advance draft you can review and approve (no public posting until sign-off)
- Provide a short anonymized quote focusing on performance outcomes rather than incident details
- Revisit publication timing in ~3–4 weeks or after your renewal conversation (whichever you prefer)

Please let me know what you prefer and if you want us to proceed with a private review copy. Apologies for the extra step — we want to be respectful of BrightWave's situation.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

P.S. Attached the form you sent for our tracking. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/78
